donor_vertical_overlap.reason: Branch winds, donor F and step water were not saved

interpretation: No accuracy threshold, fit, profile ranking, climate integration, adoption or parameter change. Numerical verification can pass while the physical interpretation remains unresolved. Internal vertical donor exchange cancels in the total column; the separately booked drying term removes column water. Existing diagnostics establish this equation distinction, not whether unresolved motions justify the additional sink. Any physical change requires a separately frozen coupled comparison under unchanged Earth safeguards.
